RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "We can use history only. Need consider measured parent behavior: Against one_D_TFT (one initial D then TFT), parent fails to recover, mutual coop last5=0, score 2.5"
STRATEGY: Parent cooperates initially, retaliates after defections, and randomly defects near the end; the trace simulates it against one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, and periodic_D; it proposes fixing last-round defection, adding forgiveness after isolated defections, and breaking mutual-defection deadlocks.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Parent issues: - Doesn't defect on last round (n==100 check is wrong). - Against TFT after initial defections, it alternates and doesn't recover because it retaliates with D after single D when op_c high? Actually parent at n=11 returns D after single D. If we change that to C when op_c is high and run==1, we fix one_D_TFT."
STRATEGY: The parent is a complex conditional strategy that cooperates initially, retaliates on defections, and forgives when opponent cooperation is high. The trace simulates the parent against one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, sustained_D, and periodic_D, finding it fails to recover against TFT-like opponents and mis-handles the last round. It proposes changes: defect on the true last round, forgive single defections when opponent cooperation is high, and break mutual-defection deadlocks after several rounds.

The trace simulates this parent against one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, and periodic_D, then revises the forgiveness and deadlock-breaking rules to improve scores.
